findings.detail: Partial all/line command prefixes were pruned on empty/create snapshots; complete-string tests missed this. Bytewise regressions now cover both branches.

Native partial escapes and old_text entities could admit impossible continuations at EOF or inside structural/coded delimiters. Prefix checks now require a viable next scalar and valid native escape position.
Invalid UTF-8 prefixes and completed non-XML scalars are rejected before committing them, including paths and CDATA.

Both deletion requests yield valid ordinary Python replacements. At the first new_text frontier raw argmax is newline and is already allowed; delete operation probe is allowed too. This does not establish the full model/KV root cause and is not a masking bypass.
Numeric range positivity/order/bounds, canonical path aliases, conflicts, inspect/read evidence, concurrent file changes, permissions and filesystem effects remain client checks.
